DS43-2026  Official Plan Amendment and Zone Change Applications - 28 South Street West - Recommendation Report
Recommended Resolution:
That the Council of the Township of Woolwich, considering Report DS43-2026 respecting Official Plan Amendment 04/2026 and Zone Change Application 04/2026 (Beyond Housing) 28 South Street West, Elmira:
Approve the Official Plan Amendment 04/2026 to increase the maximum net density on the property to 150 units per hectare, whereas a maximum of 120 units per hectare is currently permitted, in accordance with the By-law and corresponding Amendment in Attachment 3;
Amend the current site-specific provisions in Section 16.169 of the Zoning By-law to permit the following in accordance with the By-law in Attachment 4:
A reduction to the front yard setback requirement from 5 metres to 2.64 metres to accommodate a road widening; and
A reduction to the southerly side yard setback requirement that provides sole access to the rear parking area (south side yard) from 5.5 metres to 3.0 metres to permit the development of the apartment building.
Deem the changes to the application since the initial Public Meeting as minor and not require a subsequent meeting pursuant to Section 34 of the Planning Act.
